content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NIMHANS Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIMHANS Technician (EEG/Psychophysics) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the NIMHANS recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the NIMHANS recruitment is Technician (EEG/Psychophysics).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Technician (EEG/Psychophysics) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Technician post is Rs. 40000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualifications include B.Sc. in Neurophysiology Technology, B.Sc. in Neuro Science Technology, Diploma in Clinical Neurophysiology Technology, or E.E.G. Technician Course (02 yrs.).

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date is 19 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in-cum-Written Test and a Skill Test/Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the NIMHANS office in Bengaluru, Karnataka (Pincode: 560029).
